scope: independent historical Latin control only; known atomic role classes and word/paragraph boundaries; unknown shared outputs
source_partition: UDante Monarchia Book I discovery; Books II and III held; paragraph unit is a maximal contiguous annotation citation run; repeated citation labels retain their source labels and get occurrence suffixes
prefit_design_correction: Initial declared-four-suffix capacity STOP is preserved in prepared/CAPACITY.json. Before any key, fit or public registration, observationally inactive suffix parameters are excluded from inverse-identification claims just like inactive letters. Final capacity checks every suffix observed in either partition; actual source has three active suffix rules and one unused unidentifiable rule. No source, deck, recovery threshold or gain threshold changes.
output_assignments: letters bijective; suffix and wholeword assignments injective within their respective fixed candidate pools

source_family.difference: exactly last atom; equal atom length

family_factor: distinct decoded forms sharing at least one attested reference (lemma,UPOS); zero otherwise; no candidate exclusion
cut: use unigram at word boundary if either adjacent ciphertext word is a W token; other transitions unchanged

optimizer.seed_formula: 83200000 + 100*world_id + start; same seed for all arms and both conditions
optimizer.selection: highest discovery total objective; ties lowest start

incremental_information.subset: any S/W macro OR composed normalized form absent original discovery plaintext
incremental_information.rewired: diagnostic, not a substitute for OFF

order_control.interpretation: frozen held-order diagnostic; three pseudo runs do not estimate a general false-positive rate

blinding: all 120 restart fits and 15 discovery-selected fits hash-locked before evaluator accesses plaintext/key; no held-based key selection
oracle_audit: After all fits are locked, independently score the true key under each arm and compare with the selected fitted objective. Descriptive separation of search failure from objectives preferring wrong keys; no retuning or refit.
claim_ceiling: Known control architecture only; three keys are robustness replicates of the same historical content. No Voynich fit, model-class identification, language, meaning or translation. CDA001 and GDT616 remain closed.
